_readme: U1/U3 (2026-11-15): x grades (U13, PR #1335 at 484ff2c5a5, not yet merged) recorded for obj:* evidence.
Each grade is of a RE-CAPTURE of an evidence capture's script (same source sha256) taken with TradingView's x table
(session S14, xmap sidecar), graded runtime-on by the #1335 harness. No capture or source is committed here: the
re-capture lives in the local vendor-batch store until a capture-session PR commits it. A registry entry carrying
objectsX names 'capture' below as objectsXCapture; tests/test_pine_capability_admission.py (A8) holds it to this file.
Any x verdict DIVERGE vetoes the family (rollout_gate.pine_capability_admission).
